correctness.rationale: A tight-edge incidence-rank argument yields an integral potential classification exhaustive for the graph diameter. Binary potentials are indexed by three paired-label types, with incidence m^2-(a-b)^2-c and exact multinomial multiplicity; invalid singleton/constant cases and genuine three-height exceptions are corrected explicitly. Independent pair-product moment derivation gives E J=m(m-1) and Var J=m(m-1)/2, while finite corrections prove the exact raw moments; CLT plus LLN and exponentially small total-variation corrections prove the chi-square law. Parity minimization and orbit-stabilizer yield sharp extremizers and all symmetry orbits. Complete independent computer enumeration and symmetry verification for \(m=3,4,5,6\) matches all formulas. The finite tests do not stand in for the all-m proof.
